props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the button chrome onto a single child element for link semantics.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable interaction. Mirrors the native HTML attribute.

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Leading icon rendered before the label.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Render the button as a square icon-only control. Requires aria-label.

props.name: iconRight
props.description: Trailing icon rendered after the label.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional accessible label used when children are not suitable as the name.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a busy indicator and disable interaction.
